description: Who supplies, installs and services Vargov®Design compositions in a given country: the official dealer of that region (Moscow — Russia and the CIS; Hanoi — Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore; Dubai — the Persian Gulf, Middle East, Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa and every other country), the page with the dealer contacts, the brand's direct contacts, and the installation terms as published (a separate service priced individually; supervised installation available). country: a country name in English or Russian, an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, or a major city (Dubai, Moscow, Hanoi…). Without country, returns all three regions.
name: dealer_for_country
title: Official dealer for a country
